terms.gloss: a platform for a speaker or reader
evidence: Hor. Ars 279: modicīs īnstrāvit pulpita tignīs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A raised boarding for lectures, readings and actors (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: a parapet or balcony; the wall round the arena
terms.comment: Classically a projecting part of a building, and the platform round the arena where the great sat; not a speaker’s stand.

sources: Lewis & Short: pulpitum · Lewis & Short: podium
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 30, checked against the searchable text of the book.
